description: Quality results for pages in a worklist

score.description: Quality score of the page, between 0 and 1.

characters.description: Score between 0 and 1 for the length of the article.

refs.description: Score between 0 and 1 for the number of references in the article.

wikilinks.description: Score between 0 and 1 for the number of wikilinks in the article.

categories.description: Score between 0 and 1 for the number of categories in the article.

media.description: Score between 0 and 1 for the number of media files in the article.

headings.description: Score between 0 and 1 for the number of section headings in the article in relation with its length.

sources.description: Score between 0 and 1 for the number of sources in the article.

infobox.description: Whether the article has an infobox.

messagebox.description: Whether the article has a messagebox.

elements.description: Fine-grained scores that determine the article quality.
